test_custom_help: test the Hydra custom help output for an app with configuration groups and db driver options
test_job_name_no_config_override: test that a Hydra job name defaults to the script filename when no config override is provided
test_job_name_with_config_override: test that a Hydra job name is set from the config file when a config override is provided
test_job_override_dirname: test Hydra multirun sweep creates output directories named by parameter override combinations like batch_size and learning_rate
test_logging: test that Hydra job logging outputs info level messages to stdout when logging is enabled
